'''November 2000 Minneapolis tournament (14 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Minneapolis, Minnesota on 14 November 2000. It is known from Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1482">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-wheres-my-monnok-the-full-report-mixd1482/ wheres-my-monnok-the-full-report-mix], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 21 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-wheres-my-monnok-the-full-report-mixd1482/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
